description: This Java source file defines a class `GlobalConfigurationGlobalInitializerStep` that implements the `FineractGlobalInitializerStep` interface. It initializes global configuration settings related to address, interest calculation, business date, COB date adjustment, repayment days, and external ID generation using helper methods during system initialization.
